en: A colorized historic street scene showing Broerstraat in Nijmegen, with narrow brick townhouses lining a curved cobblestone street. People are walking and a cyclist rides toward the viewer. Shop signs in Dutch are visible on the façades. In the background rises a prominent church tower. Along the bottom margin, printed text identifies the location as Nijmegen and Broerstraat, with publisher details and German text.
